action_contract.matter_rule: Every matter species is minimally coupled to the same metric g_mu_nu and to no candidate gravitational field.

action_contract.on_shell_identity: nabla_mu T_m^{mu nu} = 0 when the matter equations hold
forbidden: direct dependence of S_grav on a selected matter species, J_b^mu, rho_b, or T_b^{mu nu}
